subject: MAP kickoff: NovusCare discovery follow-up & timeline options
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Patterson <anna.patterson@novuscare.com>, Miguel Martinez <mmartinez@novuscare.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-27T16:12:00-04:00
Subject: MAP kickoff: NovusCare discovery follow-up & timeline options

Hi Anna — thanks again for the time today. Quick follow-up with an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) and two practical timeline options so we can pick the right cadence. Please review and confirm: stakeholders, dependencies, and which timeline feels realistic for your internal processes.

Recap (from our call)
- Primary use case: nearline clinical summarization for provider notes (HIPAA scope discussed)
- Key dependencies: SSO/SAML, sample data export access (anonymized), procurement approval, and SOC 2 evidence

Attached: MAP_draft_20261027.xlsx (one-tab milestone view)

Timeline options (high-level)
1) Option A — Accelerated (6 weeks to POC kickoff)
  - Week 1: Stakeholder confirmation + access requests (NovusCare: Sarah engineering, Miguel procurement)
  - Week 2: Security review + onboarding (SAML test account, SOC2 evidence)
  - Weeks 3–4: POC implementation (redwood runtime, sample data ingest, telemetry)
  - Weeks 5–6: Evaluation + close decision
  - Pros: faster time-to-value; Cons: tight procurement window

2) Option B — Standard (10 weeks to POC kickoff)
  - Adds procurement buffer and dedicated time for legal review + data residency checks

Ask: can you confirm the internal owner for procurement, the security reviewer (SOC2 contact), and whether NovusCare prefers Option A or B? Also flag any hard dependencies (data residency, legal blackout dates).

Next steps (from our side)
- I will update the attached MAP with the stakeholders you confirm and mark dependencies.
- Monica (cc) will follow up with SLA and SOC2 artifacts.
- Sergio (cc) will propose technical POC scope after stakeholder confirmation.

Attachments: MAP_draft_20261027.xlsx (milestone + responsibilities)

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: NovusCare discovery follow-up & timeline options

Rafael — appreciate the clear recap and the draft. Quick answers from my side:

Stakeholder roster (please add to the MAP)
- Anna Patterson — Project Executive (me)
- Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@novuscare.com> — Engineering lead (integration/POC owner)
- Miguel Martinez <mmartinez@novuscare.com> — Procurement (primary buyer contact)
- Tanya Reid <tanya.reid@novuscare.com> — Security & Compliance
- infra-team@novuscare.com — Platform/Network (for firewall rules / IP allowlist)

Procurement note: Our standard procurement window is ~8–12 weeks for contracts requiring SLA/KMS addenda. If we aim for the 6-week accelerated option, Miguel will need a very tight internal review — it might be tight but not impossible if we parallelize security and legal.

Security: Tanya asked for SOC 2 scope and evidence (in particular whether Redwood isolates customer data in transit/at rest and KMS options). She also asked whether you support SAML SSO and SCIM provisioning.

Prefer Option B (10 weeks) as the baseline given our procurement rhythm, but we are open to Option A if Redwood can commit to a clear list of deliverables and a condensed procurement checklist.

Attached: (internal procurement timeline snippet)

Thanks — Anna
Anna Patterson
VP, Digital Transformation | NovusCare
anna.patterson@novuscare.com | (617) 555-2290

Hi Anna / team — copying the security & compliance details here and attaching an annotated SLA and a short SOC2 evidence pointer. Summary answers below: 

SOC 2 / Compliance
- We will provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report excerpt and a controls mapping (will attach SOC2-evidence-reference.txt). That should address Tanya's initial questions.

Data protection / KMS / SSO
- Data at rest: customer data is encrypted; we offer customer-managed KMS for Private deployments (on-prem / VPC).
- Data in transit: TLS 1.2+/mTLS options available for private link setups.
- SSO: SAML 2.0 is supported; SCIM provisioning is available for user sync.

Deployment options and lead times
- Hosted API (fastest): POC in 1–2 weeks after credentials and sample dataset access
- Dedicated / Private: requires provisioning + legal addenda (typical 4–8 weeks beyond initial contract)

Attachments included:
- SLA_terms_annotated.pdf (highlights on SLAs, data residency, and KMS options)
- SOC2-evidence-reference.txt (links and guidance for Tanya)

If Tanya or Miguel want a short call to walk the artifacts, I'm available Thu morning (Oct 29) and Fri afternoon.

Thanks — Monica Patel
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
